title: Max health
prompt: Members `health` at 90 and `max_health` at 100 exist. Healing can never take the robot past its maximum: health_at_max heals 30 through a `heal` helper and reports 100, not 120.
starter:
var health = 90
var max_health = 100

func health_at_max():
	return health
hints: heal adds the amount to health first, then checks the cap against max_health; health_at_max calls heal(30) and returns health.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
